displayName: Iriai — Global Lifeline-Commons (電気/水道/ガス/通信)
description: The non-profit operator of the four lifelines (ライフライン: 電気/水道/ガス/通信) AS ONE COMMONS. 入会 (iriai) = the traditional Japanese commons — collectively-held rights of use over a shared resource. The lifelines are held as a commons right of use (入会権), delivered §1.16 social-security IN-KIND (cash ≡ 0), governed 1 SBT = 1 vote. The System-of-Systems umbrella over the producer actors (hikari 光 / mizuho 水穂 / kamado 竈 / noroshi 烽) covering infra + 資金 (funding) + 管理 (management). A coverage + resilience map, NEVER a target-list, NEVER a shut-off list — a lifeline is never withheld as leverage. ASSESSMENT + R0 DESIGN ONLY — iriai never produces nor actuates; production is the producer actors' under Council Lv7+. The charter-clean inversion of the for-profit utility.
